lines.zh: : 是{i}教书{/i}啊，Onii-chan。或者说——{i}老师{/i}？

lines.en: : Because you get to experience everything first, and because we’re so close, it’s only right that you pass all of that knowledge on to {i}me{/i} so {i}my{/i} life can be a little easier.
lines.zh: : 因为你什么都比我先经历，而我们又这么亲近，所以你理应把那些知识都传给{i}我{/i}，好让{i}我的{/i}人生轻松一点。

lines.en: : Isn’t that the sole job of an older sibling, after all?
lines.zh: : 毕竟，那不就是哥哥唯一该做的工作吗？

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian22
: Onii-cha-
lines.zh: : Onii-cha——

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian23
: Disregarding...whatever that was leading to, do we have a plan in mind now? Or are we just aimlessly wandering around in hopes of not disturbing Niki’s motherly bonding opportunity?
lines.zh: : 撇开……刚才那些本来要通向什么的部分不说，我们现在有打算了吗？还是说我们只是漫无目的地瞎逛，指望别打扰 Niki 扮演母亲、培养感情的机会？

lines.en: : Noriko?
lines.zh: : Noriko？

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian24
: Oh. Well...I guess the first thing we need to figure out is whether or not you actually want to stay the whole weekend or if this is just a...{i}today{/i} sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯……我想我们首先要弄清楚的是，你是真的想整个周末都留下来，还是只是……{i}今天{/i}一天的事。

lines.en: : I’ll obviously need a place to sleep if I’m staying for more than just today. And I can’t imagine there are any rooms available if Niki’s production company booked this place for a shoot.
lines.zh: : 如果我不止待今天，那我显然需要一个睡觉的地方。而且如果 Niki 的制片公司把这里包下来拍摄了，我很难想象还会有空房。

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian25
: I can try and find you an empty one and say it’s for me? Everyone here obviously knows who I am, so I could probably pull it off.
lines.zh: : 我可以试着给你找一间空的，然后说是我要住？这里的每个人显然都知道我是谁，所以我大概能糊弄过去。

lines.en: : And I doubt there are no vacancies anyway. I think renting out the entire place was more just so Nee-chan’s fans couldn’t catch wind of the shoot and rent out rooms to creep on her.
lines.zh: : 而且我怀疑根本不会没有空房。把整个地方包下来，我觉得更多是为了不让姐的粉丝听到拍摄的风声、租房间来偷窥她。

lines.en: : Yeah. I don’t even want to think of what Chika would do if she knew Niki was here.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我连想都不敢想，如果 Chika 知道 Niki 在这里，她会干出什么。

lines.en: : Is she still deluding herself into believing you somehow don’t know my sister despite our life-long connection?
lines.zh: : 她还在自欺欺人地相信，尽管我们有一辈子的交集，你却不知怎么地不认识我姐？

lines.en: : I’ve tried telling her, but I doubt she’ll believe me unless she sees it with her own eyes. The problem with that is I likely won’t live long enough afterward to know how she reacts.
lines.zh: : 我试过告诉她，但我怀疑她不会相信，除非她亲眼看到。问题是，等她亲眼看到之后，我大概也活不了多久，看不到她的反应了。

lines.en: : You think you’d be the one in danger and not Nee-chan?
lines.zh: : 你觉得有危险的是你，而不是姐？

lines.en: : I’m not the one on posters all over her wall. I just have sex with her. Which I’m sure she’d also want to do with Niki, so...
lines.zh: : 贴满她一整面墙的海报上的人又不是我。我只是跟她上床而已。而她肯定也想跟 Niki 上床，所以……

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian26
: {i}I’d{/i} put your poster on my wall, Onii-chan. In fact, I’d buy out the whole stock.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}会把你的海报贴在我墙上的，Onii-chan。事实上，我会把整个库存都买下来。

lines.en: : Ayane could probably help you make them if you really want. She’s no stranger to hanging me on her bedroom wall.
lines.zh: : 如果你真想要，Ayane 大概能帮你做。她对于把我挂在卧室墙上这件事，可一点都不陌生。

lines.en: : I might have to do that. Especially with Ami’s birthday coming up. A shirtless poster of you would make a pretty great gift, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我也许真得那么做。特别是 Ami 的生日快到了。一张你光着上半身的海报，会是份相当棒的礼物，不是吗？

lines.en: : Better than anything {i}I{/i} could give her. At least...in terms of things that aren’t attached to my body.
lines.zh: : 比{i}我{/i}能给她的任何东西都好。至少……在那些不是长在我身上的东西里。

lines.en: : Are you liking being a dad?
lines.zh: : 当爸爸的感觉怎么样？

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian27
: Don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 也说不上来。

lines.en: : It only feels a little different. But I know it makes Ami happy, so...I think that’s where any “joy” comes from if there’s any there at all.
lines.zh: : 感觉只是稍微有点不一样。但我知道这让 Ami 很开心，所以……我想，如果这里面真有什么「喜悦」的话，那就是它的来源吧。

lines.en: : I just feel bad for your sister. She’s trying really hard and Ami just...well, you probably already know since we’re {i}here{/i} in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我只是替你姐姐感到难受。她已经很努力了，而 Ami 却……嗯，我们之所以会在{i}这儿{/i}，你大概早就知道了。

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian28
: Yeah.
: You know, it’s kind of weird. I haven’t seen her want something {i}this{/i} badly since she started training to be an idol just to get back at you.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，这挺奇怪的。自从她为了报复你而当偶像开始训练以来，我还从没见过她{i}这么{/i}想要一样东西。

lines.en: : And until Ami, I’d never really seen any interest from her in wanting to be a mom...{i}at all.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而且在 Ami 之前，我从没见过她对当妈妈这件事有{i}半点{/i}兴趣。

lines.en: : But she’s obviously older now and...I guess reconnecting with the love of her life has made her start thinking more about a future a little bigger than a poster on some girl’s wall.
lines.zh: : 可她现在显然长大了，而且……我猜，重新和一生挚爱连上线，让她开始去想一个比某个女孩墙上的海报更大的未来。

lines.en: : That’s...why I feel so bad. I can’t give that to her. Not...the way things are now, at least.
lines.zh: : 那……就是我觉得难受的原因。我没法给她那个。至少……在现在这种情况下不行。

lines.en: : Yeah...you’ve got to prioritize Ami before her. Yourself too. So I feel bad for Nee-chan as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你得把 Ami 放在她前面。你自己也是。所以我也替姐感到难受。

lines.en: : Maybe someday though. Do you agree, Onii-chan?
lines.zh: : 不过也许有一天吧。你同意吗，Onii-chan？

lines.en: : With what? Settling down?
lines.zh: : 同意什么？安定下来？

lines.en: : Yeah. Settling down. Raising kids.
lines.zh: : 嗯。安定下来。养孩子。

lines.en: : Mini-vans...trips to the beach...family-pack deals on meat at the grocery store and trying to figure out how to work the new hot pot you picked up from Hard-Off last week.
lines.zh: : 小型货车……去海边玩……在超市买家庭装的打折肉，还有研究怎么用你上周从 Hard-Off 淘回来的那只新火锅。

lines.en: : Sounds like {i}you{/i} do when you’re going to be that specific about it.
lines.zh: : 你说得这么具体，听起{i}来{/i}你确实想要。

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我确实想要。

lines.en: : It’s just sad, though...
lines.zh: : 只是有点难过……

lines.en: : Because I’m always the one going with you to buy the hot pot. Or in the backseat of that mini-van, sandwiched between two kids throwing Cheetos at each other.
lines.zh: : 因为陪你去买火锅的人永远是我。或者在小型货车的后座上，被两个互相扔奇多的小朋友夹在中间。

lines.en: : But I’m never at the table with you when you eat. I never get to sleep in the same room. Hell, the only times I get to be alone with you {i}at all{/i} are when Nee-chan visits our parents.
lines.zh: : 可你吃饭的时候，我却永远不在那张桌子旁。我也永远不能跟你睡在同一个房间。操，我能跟你独处的时刻，竟然{i}就只有{/i}姐回爸妈家的时候。

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian29
: Why is {i}that{/i} the future I envision?
lines.zh: : 为什么我憧憬的未来是{i}这个{/i}样子的？

lines.en: : Being...what, an {i}aunt?{/i}
lines.zh: : 当……什么，当{i}阿姨{/i}？

lines.en: : Is {i}this{/i} the life I subject myself to by being such a martyr all the time? I can’t even properly {i}dream{/i} now?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是我一直这么自我牺牲所换来的生活吗？我连好好做个{i}梦{/i}都不行了吗？

lines.en: : Sorry, I...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我……

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian30
: {i}Yeah.{/i}
: I don’t...really know what to say to that to-
lines.zh: : 我……真的不知道该说什么才——

lines.en: scene norikoamilesbian31
: Then don’t say anything. I’m content just knowing you’re still {i}there.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那就什么都别说。光是知道你还在{i}那儿{/i}，我就满足了。

lines.en: : And that there will always be a role for me in your life, even if it’s not the one that lands me a seat at the dinner table.
lines.zh: : 还有，在我的人生里永远都会有我的一个位置，哪怕那个位置不能让我在餐桌上占到一个座位。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...
scene norikoamilesbian32
: We were sharing that...family-pack of meat anyway, so...
lines.zh: : 反正那份家庭装的肉我们本来就是分着吃的，所以……

lines.en: : You wouldn’t have been able to eat regardless.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，你也吃不着的。

lines.en: : Maybe {i}that’s{/i} why we didn’t save you a seat.
lines.zh: : 也许{i}这{/i}就是为什么我们没给你留座位。

lines.en: : Heheh...maybe.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……也许是吧。

lines.en: : Yeah...
scene black
: Still sucks eating alone, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，一个人吃饭还是挺难受的。

lines.zh: {i}Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]！{/i}
